semiconductor_relevance: High — Toray Engineering specializes in manufacturing production equipment for various sectors, including semiconductors.
summary: Toray Engineering Co., Ltd. develops and manufactures advanced production equipment for the semiconductor industry, focusing on packaging and assembly solutions. Their expertise includes die bonding and inspection systems, catering to the needs of semiconductor manufacturers.

regional_presence.Japan: Toray Engineering has eight subsidiaries within Japan, focusing on engineering and manufacturing.
